rows.mapping_note: MOD09 is named, but as the input of MOD_PRMGR.exe, whose 500 m output MOD09GHK (not in CMR) is what MOD_PR09G.exe turns into MOD09GA. One non-archived intermediate in between, so the statement criterion is treated as weak. Matches the MOD09 run (MOD09 -> MOD09GA CHILD, MEDIUM). Version 6.1NRT matched.
rows.decision_procedure: Step 1b Q1 no. Q2 yes: T is made from MOD09's data: MOD_PRMGR.exe (PGE12) maps all MOD09 L2 granules of a day onto each sinusoidal tile (multi-observation L2G), and MOD_PR09G.exe (PGE13) sorts and compacts those observations into MOD09GA -> spatial/temporal aggregation -> aggregated_from (PARENT). PARENT vs INPUT: reprocessing MOD09 changes every MOD09GA reflectance. The L2G step passes through the non-archived MOD09GHK, which is not in CMR; the link is recorded against MOD09 (curator judgment call).
